name: amg-mcp
title: Azure Managed Grafana
summary: Query Kusto, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Prometheus, and Loki through Azure Managed Grafana, and manage its dashboards and alerts.
description: Query Kusto, Azure Monitor metrics and logs, Application Insights, Prometheus, and Loki through the data sources connected to your Azure Managed Grafana workspace. Search, read, and update dashboards and alert rules, and check Azure resource health, activity logs, and cost. Agents authenticate only to Grafana; every query runs through the workspace's existing data source connections. Also covers SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and ClickHouse data sources and Azure Resource Graph.

useCases.name: Query data and read dashboards
useCases.description: Azure Managed Grafana MCP enables AI agents to access Grafana data, including querying data sources and reading dashboards. For example, say a user wants to understand the average monthly revenue. They can ask the question of their Grafana instance, and the MCP server will translate the question into the appropriate query and return the response.

grafanaServiceAccount.description: Authenticate with Azure Managed Grafana using a Service Account access token.

grafanaOauth.description: Authenticate with Azure Managed Grafana using OAuth2 authorization code flow with PKCE support.
